selection: Single preset fixed before first training PnL. No search, no post-result promotion from ablations.
case_scope: All 124 supplied train cases, one long-option round trip each. LONG buys call, SHORT buys put. Same-day exit.
signals: Only current-session completed underlying 1m OHLCV. No scenario labels, previous sessions or option prices in indicators.
execution: Next available positive-volume option 1m close strictly after intent, at least 1 minute later; no same-bar fill, no backfill. All fills labeled simulation.
benchmark: 10:00 ET intent and 15:45 ET flatten; same engine and fill/cost model.
aggregation: Equal case premium returns and one-contract USD separately; not a compounded portfolio. Payoff is empirical, never an imposed target.
holdout_rule: Freeze code/config hash before reading evaluation bars; report final baseline and predeclared fixed-time benchmark once, never tune on holdout.
